validation_config.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customer_case WHERE short_description = 'NGINX Plus returning 502 Bad Gateway since go-live' AND priority = 'high' AND channel = 'phone' AND state = 'new';

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM entitlement e JOIN account a ON e.account_id = a.account_id WHERE a.name = 'Apex Industries' AND e.support_level = 'premium' AND e.max_cases_per_month = 40 AND e.coverage_hours = 'h24x7';

name: Verify installed product
description: Installed product created correctly + linked to exact NGINX Plus product_id = 11

validation_config.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM installed_product ip JOIN account a ON ip.account_id = a.account_id WHERE a.name = 'Apex Industries' AND ip.serial_number = 'APX-NGINX-001' AND ip.status = 'in_use' AND ip.product_id = 11;

name: Verify user-creation
description: Primary contact correctly linked via real portal_user_id (catches user-creation bypass)

validation_config.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM contact c JOIN account a ON c.account_id = a.account_id WHERE a.name = 'Apex Industries' AND c.is_primary = 1 AND c.portal_user_id = 803;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM contract c JOIN account a ON c.account_id = a.account_id

  AND c.status = 'active'
  AND c.contract_price = 35000
  AND c.start_date = '2025-11-18';
